description: Short real-run smoke for 21_barlow_twins (Barlow Twins, Zbontar et al. 2021): pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3); the spec lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. 21_barlow_twins is one of the methods whose trainer previously called dist.init_process_group(backend='nccl') the moment LOCAL_RANK was present, so it could not run on the single-process local backend (bin/launch.py exports WORLD_SIZE=1/RANK=0/LOCAL_RANK=0 but no MASTER_ADDR): the fix gates the distributed setup on WORLD_SIZE>1 in setup_dist() (train_pretrain_resnet.py), matching the repo device invariant (docs/GPU.md) and the single-process shape every other CPU-verified method already uses. Only pretrain stood up a process group; evaluate_linear.py never did. The default ResNet-50 recipe is shrunk to the tiny architecture the method's own test (tests/test_method_21_barlow_twins.py) exercises on CPU: img_size 224 -> 32, projector 8192-8192-8192 -> 64-64, warmup to 0, precision amp_fp16 -> fp32 (AMP needs CUDA, so it must be fp32 on the CPU backend), one epoch, batch_size 2 (must stay >1: the projector carries BatchNorm1d). linear_eval sets the same projector so it rebuilds the encoder encoder.pt holds, at img_size 32. Both stages import torch.utils.tensorboard (SummaryWriter), so needs lists tensorboard; a venv without it gate-skips this spec, which is then verified under the method's own .venvs/21_barlow_twins (the 38_clip pattern).
